title: The Showstopper Escape
description:
Luxury Scottsdale villa with heated pool, winter sun & resort vibes. 6BR for up to 22, minutes from Old Town, Kierland & Scottsdale Quarter. Perfect for February Waste Management Open, family, or group getaway. Heated pool & spa, fire pit, pickleball, putting green, arcade, movie lounge, golf simulator, half-court basketball, indoor/outdoor dining. Keyless entry • Fast response • Professionally cleaned.

SHORT TERM RENTAL LICENSE: 2037435

 The space 
Rooms & Spaces

Private Suites: Retreat each night to spacious, elegantly appointed bedrooms featuring premium mattresses, plush linens, and serene décor. Many offer private or semi-private bathrooms, ensuring comfort and privacy for every guest.

Nature-Inspired Movie Lounge: Step into a one-of-a-kind entertainment retreat where the outdoors meets the big screen. Our 132-inch projection screen, powered by a state-of-the-art AWOL short-throw projector, transforms the room into a private cinema—perfect for movie nights, binge-worthy series, or game-day excitement. Designed with a calming, nature-themed aesthetic, the space blends comfort with a touch of the outdoors, offering guests a cozy yet elevated vibe. The plush sectional doubles as a couch bed that sleeps up to 4, making this the ultimate spot for families, kids’ sleepovers, or friends who want to combine movie magic with a restful night’s sleep.
Whether you’re looking to unwind after a day of golf and desert adventures or create a memorable family movie night, this room is built to impress and designed to relax.

Spa-Inspired Bathrooms: Indulge in walk-in showers, soaking tub, and luxury toiletries that transform daily routines into spa moments.

Grand Living Room: A sunlit great room with soaring ceilings, designer furnishings, and walls of glass that open seamlessly to the outdoors—perfect for gathering, relaxing, or celebrating.

Gourmet Kitchen & Dining: A chef’s dream with top-tier appliances, expansive prep space, and seating for your entire group—ideal for cooking together or enjoying a catered dinner.

Entertainment Pavilion: Your own private resort hub featuring a state-of-the-art 
- Golf simulator
- lively ping pong battles
- classic arcade speedball challenges
- competitive foosball matches, a pickleball court
- a basketball court (half) 
- putting green for golf enthusiasts of all levels

A space designed for laughter, friendly rivalry, and unforgettable memories.

Outdoor Oasis: A resort-style pool and spa featuring a swim-up bar and a soothing water wall, surrounded by shaded lounge areas with a fireplace, a BBQ station, and manicured grounds enhanced with cooling outdoor misters to keep you comfortable even on the hottest days. Gather around the cozy firepit for starlit evenings filled with warmth and conversation—perfect for sun-soaked afternoons and magical nights alike.

- A pickleball court
- Half court basketball 
- Celebrity Greens Putting Green (outdoor) 
- Cornhole
- In pool seats 
- Resort style pool with LED lighting and spa 
- Firepit 
-Misting system 

Convenient Parking: Ample on-site parking to accommodate all guests with ease.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Scottsdale Highlights & Travel Times

1. Old Town Scottsdale & the Arts District
Immerse yourself in walkable galleries, stylish boutiques, Southwestern cuisine, and vibrant nightlife.
• Drive time: Approximately 10–12 minutes (about 5 miles).

2. TPC Scottsdale & Waste Management Phoenix Open
Home to the famed Stadium Course and its electrifying 16th-hole coliseum—this is golf like no other.
• Drive time: Around 12–15 minutes (roughly 6–7 miles).

3. Taliesin West
Explore Frank Lloyd Wright’s iconic desert compound and creativity hub—an architectural marvel you won't want to miss.
• Drive time: Circa 15 minutes (approx. 7 miles).

4. Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show & Barrett-Jackson Auction (WestWorld)
From the grandeur of the Arabian Horse Show to the classic car excitement at Barrett-Jackson and festive Parada del Sol, WestWorld delivers unmatched cultural flair.
• Drive time: About 15 minutes (6–8 miles).

5. Arizona Boardwalk Attractions
A family entertainment cluster featuring OdySea Aquarium, Butterfly Wonderland, Museum of Illusions, and more—perfect for all ages.
• Drive time: Approximately 15 minutes (6–7 miles).

6. Luxury Spas, Shopping & Nightlife
Spoil yourself at resorts like The Phoenician or enjoy high-end fashion and evening glamour at Scottsdale Fashion Square.
• Drive time: Roughly 10–12 minutes to Scottsdale Fashion Square, and similar to nearby resort venues.

Why Staying Here Is a Smart Choice
• Central Location: You’re nestled in a serene upscale neighborhood that provides a peaceful refuge—yet you're just minutes from everything that makes Scottsdale unforgettable.
• Something for Everyone: Whether it's art, history, golf, horses, family fun, or luxury indulgence, your guests won’t have to travel far.
• Quick Access: With most top attractions just a short drive away, guests can maximize their time—whether they’re here for weekend play or a multi-day retreat.

 Guest access 
You will have secure, keyless entry to the villa via a Yale smart lock. A unique access code will be provided to you shortly before your arrival for convenience and safety. This code is personal and confidential—please do not share it with anyone outside your party.

If you need any assistance with the lock or entry process during your stay, feel free to contact us anytime.

 Other things to note 
🌿 Welcome to Our Home

Welcome to a thoughtfully designed luxury retreat created for comfort, relaxation, and a peaceful stay. We’re delighted to host you and want to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience from the moment you arrive.

This home has been curated with care and attention to detail, and we kindly ask all guests to treat it with the same level of respect so every stay remains exceptional.

---

⚡ Quick Stay Essentials

• 👥 Only registered guests permitted (no unapproved visitors)
• 🚫 No parties, events, or unapproved gatherings
• 🚭 No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property
• 🔇 Quiet hours: 11 PM – 7 AM
• 👟 Shoes must be removed indoors
• 🏊 Pool & spa use at guests’ own risk; children must be supervised
• 🚨 Pool safety alarms must not be tampered with or disabled
• 🧹 Stays over 7 nights include required mid-stay cleaning
• ⛳ Golf simulator available with additional fee (advance request required)
• ⚙️ Please respect all locked or restricted areas and appliances
• 🧼 Kindly leave the home in a reasonably tidy condition
• 📘 A printed information binder may be available, but guests must refer to the latest platform or direct communications for current information
• 🛠️ Scheduled maintenance and service providers may periodically visit the property during daytime hours for routine upkeep

---

📘 Guest Information Binder
For guest convenience, a printed information binder may be available at the property. While we do our best to keep all materials updated, certain information in printed materials may occasionally become outdated. Please refer to the latest information, house rules, and instructions provided through your booking platform or direct guest communications for the most current and applicable details regarding your stay.

---

🏡 The Space

A private luxury home designed for families, group stays, and extended visits. Guests enjoy comfort, privacy, and well-maintained indoor and outdoor amenities.

---

 👥 Guest Occupancy & Gatherings

The number of guests must not exceed your reservation.

Gatherings, parties, or any additional visitors beyond registered guests are strictly not permitted without prior written approval.

---

🔇 Quiet Hours & Neighbor Respect

Quiet hours are from 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Guests are required to maintain respectful noise levels at all times to ensure a peaceful environment for neighbors and the surrounding community.

---

👟 Shoes & Entry Care

Shoes and sandals must be removed before entering the home to protect the flooring and maintain cleanliness.

A shoe rack is provided at the entrance. If full, footwear may be placed neatly at the front entrance area.

High-heeled footwear such as stilettos is not permitted indoors due to flooring protection.

Indoor slippers are welcome, and guests are encouraged to bring their own for added comfort.

---

🚗 Parking & Security

Parking is available on the street where permitted and in the driveway.

Blocking neighboring driveways or access points is strictly prohibited.

Exterior security cameras are installed outdoors only (no interior cameras).

Please ensure all doors and windows are locked when leaving the property.

---

 🗑️ Trash & Recycling

All trash must be bagged before disposal.

Trash must be placed in black bins by Tuesday 12:00 PM. 

Recycling must be placed in pink bins by Sunday 12:00 PM.

Our maintenance team will push the bins to the curb for pickup and return them afterward.

Improper disposal may result in additional cleaning charges.

---

🛠️ Scheduled Property Maintenance

To help maintain the home and outdoor amenities to a high standard, scheduled service providers may periodically visit the property during daytime hours for routine maintenance and upkeep.

• 🌿 Gardener – Every other Tuesday (2nd and 4th Tuesday) 
• 🏊 Pool Maintenance Team – Every Thursday 
• 🐞 Pest Control Team – Mid-month scheduled service 
• 🗑️ Trash & Recycling Service Team – Tuesday and Sunday

Our maintenance and service teams work outdoors whenever possible and aim to minimize any disruption to guests.

---

 🏊 Pool & Spa

Pool and spa amenities are available for guest enjoyment.

An additional fee applies for pool heating, currently $325 per night (subject to change), minimum 3 nights, and must be booked for the full duration of the stay. Spa heating is complimentary.

These rates and conditions are subject to change and may apply to existing reservations where applicable.

Pool heating maintains approximately 80–85°F depending on weather conditions.

Pool & spa usage is at guests’ own risk. Guests must supervise children at all times.

Pool and spa waivers must be signed prior to use.

To help maintain efficiency and equipment longevity, please turn off pool and spa systems when not in use.

No glass is permitted in or around the pool area. Drinks and light refreshments are allowed, but we kindly ask that all items and debris are cleaned and removed after use.

Pool safety alarms are installed on all exterior doors leading to the pool and must not be tampered with or disabled. Removal or tampering with alarm batteries is strictly prohibited and may result in damage charges.

---

🚨 Pool Safety Alarms

Pool safety alarms are installed on all exterior doors leading to the pool. These systems must not be tampered with, disabled, or interfered with in any way. Removal or tampering with alarm batteries is strictly prohibited and may result in damage charges.

---

 ⛳ Golf Simulator

An additional fee applies for use of the golf simulator. Advance request is required to ensure setup and availability. Please contact us for further details.

---

 🍳 Kitchen & Cooking

Guests are welcome to use all indoor and outdoor cooking appliances.

Please turn off all appliances after use and clean cooking surfaces including grills, drip trays, and oil catch areas.

---

🧼 Cleanliness & Care

Guests are expected to maintain a reasonably tidy condition throughout their stay.

Excessive mess, stains, odors, or unsanitary conditions (including biohazard-level cleanup requirements) may result in additional cleaning charges.

---

🧹 Mid-Stay Cleaning (7+ Nights)

For stays longer than 7 nights, a scheduled mid-stay cleaning is required to maintain luxury standards.

Cleanings occur approximately every 7 days and are coordinated in advance with guests at a convenient time.

Service options will be shared after booking for selection and scheduling convenience.

---

⚙️ Appliances & Utilities

All appliances, lights, TVs, and systems must be turned off when not in use and upon checkout.

Locked or owner-marked appliances (including indoor and outdoor storage units, refrigerators, or cabinets) are strictly off-limits. Any tampering may result in damage charges.

---

 🔑 Keys & Access

Lost or unreturned keys, including those for restricted areas such as utility or network rooms, will incur replacement charges.

---

🚭 Smoking & Vaping

Smoking and vaping are strictly prohibited anywhere on the property, indoors and outdoors. Violations may result in additional cleaning and odor remediation charges.

---

 🛏️ Check-Out

Please place used towels in the laundry basket and ensure dishes are cleaned before departure.

The home should be left in a reasonably tidy condition.

---

✨ A Note From Us

We want your stay to feel effortless, comfortable, and memorable. These guidelines help us maintain a high standard of cleanliness, safety, and experience for every guest.

We truly appreciate your care and understanding.
